verse.verse_1: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verse.verse_2: Who created all things and fashioned them in good proportion;
verse.verse_5: and then made it into a blackish straw.
verse.verse_6: We shall make you recite and then you will not forget,
verse.verse_7: except what Allah should wish. He knows all that is manifest and all that is hidden.
verse.verse_8: We shall ease you to follow the way of Ease.
verse.verse_9: So render good counsel if good counsel will avail.
verse.verse_10: He who fears (Allah) shall heed it,
verse.verse_11: but the wretched will turn away from it.
verse.verse_12: He will be cast into the Great Fire.
verse.verse_13: Then he will neither die in it, nor live.
verse.verse_14: He who purified himself shall prosper,
verse.verse_15: remembering his Lord's name and praying.
verse.verse_16: No; but you prefer the present life,
verse.verse_17: whereas the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verse.verse_18: This, indeed, was in the ancient Scrolls,
verse.verse_19: the Scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
